p1.name: Heat-pipe microreactor
p1.note: Heat pipes carry heat to a converter and vertical fins. Dust tolerance and shielding require site tests.
p1.inbound: Power modules, crew stores and survey equipment

p2.name: Gas-cooled Brayton station
p2.note: Helium carries heat to an intermediate exchanger and closed Brayton power block. The working fluid requires purification and compression.

dfr.name: Dual-fluid station
dfr.note: Separate hot circuits, a standby supply and an insulated drain vault are shown. Materials qualification is a deployment gate.
dfr.inbound: Industrial power modules and specialist components

fusion.name: Magnetic fusion station
fusion.note: The fusion heat collection system feeds a separate power cycle. Deployment depends on terrestrial demonstration, serviceability and a viable fuel inventory.
fusion.inbound: Qualified fusion components and commissioning equipment
